title: Compound/UNI — Price Feeder Manipulation via Incomplete Liquidation Analysis
root_cause: Compound's UNI market price feeder referenced Balancer AMM spot prices, making it manipulable via large single-block swaps — excessive UNI borrowing followed by incomplete liquidation resulted in bad debt
